messages:
elaine: heads-up: a cluster of premerge SAST runs started failing for changes touching our regex-based JSON parser. CI logs show the SARIF collector couldn't decrypt the test fixtures from the keystore, so results couldn't be annotated and PRs are blocked. anyone touched keystore policies overnight?

vic: that was me. i narrowed an IAM binding on the keystore to remove a broad editor role for serviceaccounts. intended to limit blast radius, but i didn't realize the sarif-collector in the pipeline uses the legacy `scanner-daemon@` SA for test fixture decryption. my bad.

tor: paste the CI failure snippet so we can confirm it's a KMS issue and not a SARIF parser crash.

elaine: CI excerpt: 
```
[sarif-collector] ERROR: decrypt fixture failed
reason: kms:Decrypt permission denied
resource: projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/sdrc/cryptoKeys/sast-test-key
collector: exit status 2
```

vic: yup KMS:Decrypt. i can revert but i'd rather do an ephemeral grant and patch infra so this doesn't reoccur.

sec-bot: audit event detected: principal=vic@redwood.com action=iam.setPolicy resource=projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/sdrc timestamp=2025-11-21T22:03:11Z audit_id=AL-20251121-2203. policy_change: removed binding role/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter -> members: serviceAccount:scanner-daemon@redwood.

tor: thanks sec-bot. can we get the exact policy diff attached to the incident? we need it for the post-change approvals doc.

evidence-bot: attached audit diff to evidence bundle EB-20251121-13 and linked failing SARIF artifacts from the last 10 runs. evidence id EB-20251121-13.

elaine: triage proposal: 1) issue an ephemeral grant to the scanner SA for 2h so blocked PRs can progress; 2) run a smoke job that exercises KMS decrypt path in staging; 3) infra PR to update IAM mapping & require `keystore-smoke:passed` before merging keystore IAM diffs; 4) add SARIF fingerprinting so suppressions survive vendor rule id churn.

vic: i'm spinning up the ephemeral grant now via infra-bot: `/infra-bot grant scanner-daemon@2h cloudkms.decrypt sast-test-key`. will post the grant id.

infra-bot: ephemeral grant created: principal=scanner-daemon@redwood service=cloudkms role=roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter resource=sast-test-key expires=2025-11-21T24:03:00Z request_id=RQ-8801.

tor: re-run the blocked CI jobs while grant is active. also, we should add a premerge check that prevents merging any keystore policy change without a green smoke run. i'll open infra#600 to add the check and a `keystore-smoke` pipeline job.

elaine: for SARIF fingerprinting: nina suggested earlier the algorithm should be normalized_message + relative_path + snippet_hash (sha1 of tokenized 3-line context). that should be stable across vendor id renames. put it in the collector and backfill suppression mappings.

vic: i'll include a terraform policy mapping the scanner-daemon SA to the explicit binding and a sample smoke job in infra#600. posting PR when ready.

evidence-bot: smoke-run results uploaded: smoke-20251121-01 -> decrypt path exercised, all checks passed. attached to EB-20251121-13.

tor: infra#600 opened: patch includes IAM binding, smoke job, and premerge gate. reviewers: @elaine, @vic.

elaine: please ensure the PR includes: 1) audit-log export link, 2) CLI snippet to reproduce smoke test locally, 3) rollback steps, and 4) a runbook note that any keystore IAM change requires attaching evidence bundle + smoke-green before merge.

vic: will add those items. quick note: let's also enforce an `approval:security` label for keystore/infrastructure IAM changes so sec gets a direct notify.

sec-bot: incident ticket created SEC-2025-842 severity=medium. linked=[AL-20251121-2203, RQ-8801, EB-20251121-13, infra#600]. recommended follow-ups: backfill suppression fingerprints, add keystore-change checklist, create RBAC perm matrix doc.

elaine: team, i've re-run the 9 blocked PRs; 8 are green now. one still fails with unrelated unit test flake. marking incident as mitigated pending infra#600 merge. i'll draft the short postmortem with timeline, diffs, evidence id, and remediation action items.

vic: sorry for the disruption. learned lesson: least-privilege changes need a smoke canary and audit artifact by default.

tor: closing loop: infra PR reviewers please prioritize, sec to review runbook, and collector team to schedule fingerprint backfill next week. thanks all. :thumbsup:
